answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 564 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to use Interest money from Banks to pay Income tax to government? Question: Assalamalaikum Is it permissible to use Interest money from Banks to pay Income tax to government? Jazakallah Answer ID: 564 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 756=525/H) It is allowed. This has been discussed at length in Fatawa Mahmoodiah, vol 4. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
